text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought an injured Curren Chan
to the nurse's office, but...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm…… Big Brother, Curren thinks she'd perk up
if she had something sweet~"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Mmm…… Big Sister, Curren thinks she'd perk up
if she had something sweet~"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...*sigh*, I'm so anxious about that magazine feature coming out today that I can't relax at all~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, maybe I'd like to take a cute picture
of Curren outside with the sky...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but Curren shouldn't overdo it,
so Big Brother has to carry me piggyback. Okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but Curren shouldn't overdo it,
so Big Sister has to carry me piggyback. Okay?♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is it because she got hurt, or perhaps despite the fact that she's injured?
...It feels like she's making quite a few requests lately.
choice_data_list: You're actually doing fine, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is it because she got hurt, or perhaps despite the fact that she's injured?
...It feels like she's making quite a few requests lately.
choice_data_list: You're actually doing fine, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay. Ehehe,
Big Brother is so sweet~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay. Ehehe,
Big Sister is so sweet~

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it's okay
to scold them just a little bit, you know.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Because Curren... got hurt,
so she's not cute right now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...I ended up spending the entire day taking care of Curren Chan to tend to her injury.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe☆ You found me out?
choice_data_list: ...Do you want to get back to practice?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just lazing around isn't cute at all, so I guess I'm in the mood to get moving a bit.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look, Onii-chan. See?
Curren is this much—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Look, Onee-chan. See?
Curren is this much—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Kya!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe, my bad, my bad☆
That was just a fluke, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, Curren Chan still wasn't feeling well after that...
so I decided to have her take a proper rest for the day.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Full of energy☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehe♪ Curren's gonna get way, way,
suuuper cuter, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And she threw herself into training,
as if to make up for the time she spent resting in bed.
